summary: Teaches defining an availability SLI and creating an SLO with the Grafana SLO wizard, then reading the error budget burndown.

needs.description: Prometheus-compatible data source (e.g. grafanacloud-prom) selectable in the SLO wizard so Ratio query appears.
needs.evidence: create-availability-slo: input[aria-label="Select a data source"]; "Ratio query appears when you select a Prometheus-compatible data source"

needs.description: Counter metrics like http_requests_total with a status label returning data (success=status!~"5..", total) for the wizard queries and 90-day predictions; could use grafanacloud-play-prom QuickPizza metrics as substitute.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: "Metrics flowing into Grafana Cloud"; wizard example http_requests_total{status!~"5.."}

needs.description: Existing folder selectable for the SLO (or learner creates one).
needs.evidence: configure-targets: select an existing folder or Create folder

needs.description: An SLO exists in the list for the monitor-slo milestone; the path itself creates it in earlier milestone.
needs.evidence: monitor-slo: Click on your SLO name

reviewNotes: Metric names in guide are generic; seeded data must match whichever metric the test types. SLO creation generates recording rules/dashboards on the shared stack.
